texto: Listening at food stalls: in the bustle of Thai markets, you will often hear short, direct phrases. Distinguish «ขอน้ำครับ» [khɔ̌ɔ náam khráp], with a rising tone on ขอ and a high tone on น้ำ, from «ไม่เผ็ดค่ะ» [mâi phèt khâ], with falling and low tones. Catching the marker «ไม่» at the start of a quality is key to knowing whether a dish is spicy or not.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ข้าวสวยร้อนๆ เป็นอาหารหลักในแทบทุกมื้อของคนไทยทุกภาค» express?

opciones.texto: Freshly cooked rice is the undisputed staple of every meal.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ข้าวสวยร้อนๆ เป็นอาหารหลักในแทบทุกมื้อของคนไทยทุกภาค» from the text.

opciones.texto: Ordering street food relies on direct verbs such as «khɔ̌ɔ» and «ao».
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the text, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Herbal drinks and fruit juices effectively relieve the heat of spicy food.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.
